caption: The worked example flows down the stack: capture gives 640×480 at 30 frame/s, the separate video and audio codecs produce 221.184 Mbit/s and 1.4112 Mbit/s, and the buffer and sync stage is the one place where the two streams are joined onto one clock at 222.5952 Mbit/s. The same 2-minute clip then needs 3.34 GB on disk before it can be delivered and played out.

spec.title: Six stages carrying the worked example
spec.aria: A downward pipeline: capture at 640×480 and 30 frame/s feeds a video codec at 221.184 Mbit/s and an audio codec at 1.4112 Mbit/s, both joining at the buffer and sync stage with a total of 222.5952 Mbit/s, then storage holding 3.34 GB for a 2-minute clip, network delivery, and presentation at 30 frame/s and 44.1 kHz.
